s1.title: Add an MCP tool to your site
s1.text: Register a tool with WebMCP: a name, a description and a JSON schema. The technology is experimental: browsers are expected to ship it in early 2027. Until then it needs [the polyfill from our widget](/docs/polyfill/).

s2.title: Connect a channel
s2.text: Create a channel in the admin panel and get its publishable key.

s3.title: Add the widget
s3.text: Paste the widget with the key from your channel.

s4.title: Send a request through the widget
s4.text: The orchestrator plans the steps and calls your tool in the visitor's browser.

s5.title: See the decision graph in the admin
s5.text: Less of a black box: see where it goes wrong, what each run costs and what it brings in.
